jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.seniority: 4+ years of software, solutions, or customer-facing technical experience

evidence.source_text: The required background is expressed as relevant experience rather than a degree requirement.

concerns: Customer deployments and white-glove support may create less predictable scheduling than a product-only role.

why_it_fits: The approved Forward Deployed Engineer title is paired with production engineering and direct customer delivery.
The role implements and extends the integration product that supplies real-time context to AI agents.
The official posting confirms San Francisco, hybrid work, full-time employment, and a published base maximum above $200,000.
concerns: The AI work is integration infrastructure rather than user-interface product development.
The published range is unusually wide and only its maximum clears the threshold.
The customer-facing delivery model may be less predictable than a core product role.

evidence.source_text: The posting was listed in Ampersand's current public Ashby feed.
The role implements and extends Ampersand in customer environments; the posting defines Ampersand as infrastructure delivering context to AI agents.
The posting requests 4+ years of relevant engineering or customer-facing technical experience.
